scene_purpose: Track the territorial Elder Thornhide from Cresthaven, resolve the conflict nonlethally, and establish Last Sentinel's first verified modern manifestation as its Recovered transition without explaining Prime-system mechanics or Awakening.

scene_context_seed.location_name: forest edge / Elder Thornhide territorial space
scene_context_seed.runtime_note: Exact battle state, HP/MP, encounter timing, weather, and live traversal state come from runtime. Dialogue may occur only at authored noncombat stops and aftermath.

current_floor_state.elder_thornhide: alive; territorial; dangerous; current conflict materially linked to Cresthaven reoccupation; mandatory outcome is drive-off/retreat, not kill
current_floor_state.last_sentinel_at_scene_start: confirmed by the First Command Warden; Cyanis's Card stable deep Ruby; no verified modern manifestation; not yet Recovered
current_floor_state.last_sentinel_scene_transition: during the Elder Thornhide encounter, Last Sentinel manifests for the first verified modern time and becomes Recovered; this is the Recovered acquisition/transition event
current_floor_state.prime_knowledge: Prime Card remains an Ancient term/hypothesis. The party does not know the Prime system, activation rule, or why Last Sentinel manifested.
current_floor_state.creature_intent: territorial/defensive behavior supported by evidence; do not turn it into deliberate human malice

allowed_information_transfers: Torren may transfer field observations and bounded animal/track inferences he personally earns during tracking.
The party may carry forward the shared Chapter-3 Warden/Ruby facts and the unproven Prime Card hypothesis.
Author-only Prime combat rules may govern the event but must not become character exposition.
No character may speak during active combat.
